Many HOSTILE CREATURES stand in your way, savage beasts and demons summoned by dark rites and knowledge best left forgotten. The only way to combat these monsters is with your powerful fists and sharp reflexes. There are also traps and obstacles that cannot be destroyed, but can be avoided if timed correctly.

Will you fight for the SOUL OF THE BEAST?

471649.overview:
In a not too far dystopian future you must evade the ruthless henchmen of corrupt authorities and make your way through a deadly maze of moving walls.

It is your mission to guide your avatar from the bottom of each of the 66 level screens to the top while not getting hit by the walls to finally find your way out into freedom.

Difficulty
The game supports two difficulties - hard (originally the normal mode) and easy. The desired difficulty can be selected in the main menu by using the joystick button.

In easy mode, the sine wave patterns are a little bit slower (25.6 seconds max. period time) than in hard mode (17 seconds) but also the runner moves slower to don't make it too easy.

Running
The game is single player and is played with the joystick in the left port. You have unlimited lives, there is no such thing as a game over. When you die because being hit by a wall, you press the joystick button and will immediately be reincarnated on bottom of the screen to go again.

The number in the bottom right corner of the screen shows the current try you are doing in the ongoing level. The upper left corner alternating shows your current score (orange/yellow) or the green 3-digit code identifying the current level. You can later use this code to directly start from this specific level using the "Resume" function in the main menu.

When you have reached the top of a screen, your score increases by the value shown in the upper left. Press the joystick button to enter the next level.

You may skip a level by just walking out of the screen to the right. You should feel really bad in doing so. Note that you will not get any points for a skipped level nor you won't receive the big bonus points at the end of the game if you have skipped one or more levels.

During gameplay, you may toggle the wall sound on/off using the "Select" button of the console.

Scoring
You receive points based on the number of attempts you need to complete a level. The score increment is the difference of your needed trries to a fixed reference value of tries for that specific level (plus three bonus points). The reference values ascend from 1 (level 1) to 22 (level 66). If you need more tries than the reference value, you still get 1 point.

If you haven't skipped a level and didn't start the game using the "Resume" function, you will be given a bonus of 75 extra points on completion of level 66. Best score for level 1 is 3 points and 99 points for level 66 (24 + 75). Highest reachable score is hence 966 points.

Scoring is the same in easy and hard mode.

Resume
The resume function can be selected from the main menu. Enter the three digits of the level you want to start from using the joystick up/down and the joystick button. After you have entered the third digit, the game will search for the corresponding level and start it. If the code is unknown, the game will return to the main menu.

Random
The random generator creates levels by random which can then be played.

471771.overview:
Mission: Stop die Glocke, the Nazi bell.

You play Lieutenant Mariotti, commander of the tank.
You have 10 minutes to reach "die Glocke" before it is activated.
During the mission, you will encounter several obstacles.
Most of them are stationary, except for an ambulance travelling in the opposite direction to your tank and a blue lorry loaded with explosives, which is travelling slower than you.
There is also a stationary blue lorry, which does not contain anything.

Warning: The tank can be damaged in the following cases:
- Collision with any object along the route (except the ambulance)
- If you shoot at the ambulance
- If it is hit by the explosion of the blue lorry carrying explosive supplies for the Nazi bell.
- If you are hit by bombs from the bomber following you.

After 6 hits, the mission fails.

471821.overview: Not satisfied with the version of Space Invaders Atari created for the 2600? Would you like one that more closely resembles the arcade version? Rob Kudla has taken Atari's Space Invaders and modified the graphics, colors and sounds to make it truer to the original. Amazing that Atari didn't do this themselves!

471933.overview:
A side-scroller/platformer called “Sand Castles”. Here’s a quick run-down…

Shoot to defeat monsters to clear each round (if you spend to much time in a level, you’ll get chased by the “reaper”).
Health bar is to the bottom-right, lives to the bottom left.
Left difficulty switch to control game difficulty (b=longer time before reaper, health restored each level).
Right difficulty switch turns music on/off.
Works with SEGA Genesis controllers with multiple buttons supported: B to shoot, C to jump – of course it also works with the 2600 joystick, where “up” jumps.

471935.overview: Explore space, use the navigation map on the bottom of the screen for guidance. Shoot asteroids, aliens - don't get hit. Find all 4 planets. Land on the planet, defeat the boss, get a power up (multi-ships, etc). Return to the starting base.

471938.overview:
It's an intergalactic rescue mission!  Your job, should you choose to accept it, is to rescue as many trapped astronauts as possible from our fleet of nine ships.  Each ship has a limited supply of oxygen represented by the meter at the top of the screen.  Rescue as many astronauts as you can before it runs out, once the oxygen meter gets all the way to the right you will be transported to the next ship. 

Using your specially equipped fighter, you can enter the federation ship and rise through the tunnels to the eighth floor to get to the trapped astronauts.  You can only carry one at a time. Once you pick them up, transport them back to the bottom docking area and they will exit the ship for rescue. In your path is a security system gone awry, you'll need to shoot and/or avoid the regulators and completely avoid the moving security doors.  Regulators will be regenerated after a period of time, so be careful.  Security Doors cannot be destroyed and must be avoided. You will receive 10 points for each Regulator you destroy, and 100 points for each astronaut that is rescued. After running out of oxygen on the ninth ship, the game will end.  There are no bonus ships in this game, so tread carefully! Go for the high score!

472046.overview:
Asteroids not hard enough for you? Now it is. This hack of Asteroids ups the difficulty considerably by changing how the asteroids move. They will now close in on you faster. Your only hope, the thrusters on your ship have been given a boost. If you can't out shoot, maybe you can out run.

The hack features vector graphics, increased thrust on the player sprite, and new horizontal movement for the asteroids.

472063.overview: This is an adaption of a board game from the 80s. It's made to look like it was an official 80s release. It's a simple game of dice where you must get rid of all your sticks and put them into the holes of the board (except when the hole is already occupied by a stick - then you have to take that one and the other player continues). You may choose to roll the dice as long as you want or you have to take a stick (except for the first round where you only roll the dice once). Getting a 6 means you always can lay down a stick in the big pot.

472065.overview: Video City a modern sprawling metropolis, a home to movie stars, athletes and the common man. It's a city with a TRASH problem. Now it's time to jump in the truck, rev up the engine, and get cleaning!

472130.overview:
From the top, stalactites will grow towards the bottom. When one reaches the bottom, the game is over. Also drips will fall from the stalactites. When they reach the bottom or collide with your gun, you will lose energy. If all your energy is lost, the game ends. Use your rapid gun fire to control the stalactite growth and to destroy the falling drips.

Occasionally, power-ups will fall from the top, which you can collect with your gun. They will provide e.g. more fire power and extra energy.

The game is played in waves, each lasting 60 seconds. After each wave, the screen is cleared and you get some extra energy. With FIRE, you start the next, harder wave.

474188.overview:
You are a retired race car driver who spent his entire career in the shadow of more successful drivers. But even so, it has brought you enough money to live in relative comfort. You've spent your whole life fighting your inner demons. You drank, met many women, and in the end you underachieved. You feel like you could have done so much better if only you weren't so weak back then.

So here you sit - old and grumpy, drowning in self pity. Suddenly, you feel an urge to fight your way out of this pit of despair. "Yeah, that’s it!" you say to yourself. "I’ll visit all my favourite tracks and break my old records! And if I find someone to race, we’ll have a duel!"

You buy your plane tickets and set out on your mission…

HOW TO PLAY
Use the fire button as a gas pedal, joystick left/right for steering.

When the race starts, you have to wait for the green light (or the 3rd audio blip), and at the same moment, hit the fire button. If you hit it too early, you won’t go anywhere, and you’ll have to release the fire button and press it again. Steering is disabled when your car is stationary, just like you’d expect in real life.

You always have to complete five laps, after which the race will end. If you’re fast as the wind, you may get golden time, which means you've
beaten your old record. If you’re a bit slower, you may achieve silver or bronze times.

476148.overview:
Defend the futuristic city of NeoCov from bizarre alien insect invaders! Your mission is to intercept and eliminate the enemies before they reach the city center.

Use the fire button to shoot down the alien threats, but there's a catch, you can only carry 6 bullets at a time. Drop down into NeoCov city centre to reload, beware however, whilst in the city you are unable to shoot.

If you see a falling "P" be sure to collect it, this will add 50 points to your score, reset you bullets and clear the screen of enemies

Colliding with an enemy, an enemy bullet or allowing an enemy to reach the city will result in a game over!

Don't worry if you find yourself dying super often, Sky Saviour is meant to be played in short, intense sessions.

Scoring
The fewer bullets you have left, the more points you earn for each shot. For example, if you have 6 bullets left, each successful shot gives you 1 point, but if you have only 1 bullet left, each successful shot gives you 6 points. Try not to reload too often to maximize your score

477209.overview:
Your job is to help Zara the Clever Squirrel collect all the acorns. She's put them all on a long stairway reaching up to the sky, but there's a catch...
Zara is an exceptionally tricky squirrel and to keep any other squirrels from raiding her cache she's made it so you can't walk straight up the stairs - you have to jump instead.
There's a number on each stair indicating how far you jump, up or down, but no more and no less.
Jump too far off either end of a stairway and you'll fall, luckily Zara is also quite agile and will catch herself.
Get to the top of all the stairs and you'll get a special prize...
 
Additional game modes:
"lavas" mode: one of Zara's science experiments has gone awry again and now the valley is filling with lava. Get to the top of the stairs as fast as you can!
"darks" mode: it's dark and all you can see is the square you are on and the one in front of you. Can you still make it to the top?
"leets" mode: dark + lava: How much do you like steps puzzles? if the answer is  "a lot", "leet" mode may be for you

478612.overview:
A demake of the Homestar Runner graphic adventure game.  Press reset/fire to start. Use the joystick to move.  You are Strong Bad (the Red Box).  You need to collect the secret that looks nothing like you (the Yellow Box).  

Avoid the pulsing blue walls, which will zap you and reset your position and reduce your speed.  You need to collect the secret before time runs out on the timer bar.  A speed boost (a Blue Box) will make you go faster. You can collect up to 3 of these at a time.  Bonus points if you complete a level without touching any walls.  Collect as many secrets as you can before the duck gets you!.
